properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.access-key
properties.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. If not set, the aws.accessKeyId system property or the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID environment variable is used. It is required, unless transcribeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.configuration
properties.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.aws2.transcribe.Transcribe2Configuration type.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the aws2-transcribe component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.operation
properties.description: The operation that the producer performs. It is required, as no header replaces it: a producer without an operation fails the exchange.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.override-endpoint
properties.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.pojo-request
properties.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartTranscriptionJobRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.profile-credentials-name
properties.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.proxy-host
properties.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.proxy-password
properties.description: The password for the proxy. It is not used: the Transcribe client that the component builds does not authenticate to the proxy.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.proxy-port
properties.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.proxy-protocol
properties.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.proxy-username
properties.description: The user name for the proxy. It is not used: the Transcribe client that the component builds does not authenticate to the proxy.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.region
properties.description: The AWS region of Amazon Transcribe, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the aws.region system property or the AWS_REGION environment variable is used, and else the default region provider chain of the AWS SDK.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.secret-key
properties.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. If not set, the aws.secretKey system property or the AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variable is used. It is required, unless transcribeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.session-token
properties.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.transcribe-client
properties.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.transcribe.TranscribeClient. When this option is set, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The endpoint does not close this client, but the component closes a client that is set on the component when the component stops. The option is a software.amazon.awssdk.services.transcribe.TranscribeClient type.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.trust-all-certificates
properties.description: Whether the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.uri-endpoint-override
properties.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.use-default-credentials-provider
properties.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.use-profile-credentials-provider
properties.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.use-session-credentials
properties.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-transcribe.protocol
properties.description: This option has no effect: the Transcribe client uses HTTPS, or the scheme of uriEndpointOverride when overrideEndpoint is true. For the protocol of the proxy, use proxyProtocol. Deprecation note: Not used: nothing reads this option when the Transcribe client is built
